title: Angler at 150% zoom (portrait phone) squeezes the fishing scene to 27x41 px: unplayable
steps: Open game/games/angler/index.html at an effective 260x563 CSS px viewport (390x844 phone at 150% text/zoom, touch)
Close the how-to card, tap the water to cast and hook a fish
expected: Scene keeps a usable size (page scrolls, as the 2026 bugbash fix intended: scene >= 250 px)
actual: Scene 200x300 at 260x563 (touch), header/status still tight (title "WES...", Bells chip clipped at right edge) but playable.
suspect: game/games/angler/angler.css (flex layout of #stage / #scene; min-height lost when the chrome is tall)

title: Angler in landscape phone: lower half of the scene and the reel meter are below the fold
steps: Open the Angler at 844x390 touch, cast and hook a fish
expected: Scene and reel meter fully visible while reeling (no scroll mid-reel)
actual: 844x390: scene y=8..329 fully visible while reeling; 563x260: scene 131x197 at y=8, page 282 vs 260 viewport (small scroll only for the message box).

title: Jam at 150% zoom portrait: the four touch pads are pushed below the fold during play
steps: Open Campfire Jam at 260x563 touch (390x844 at 150%)
Start Warm Embers Normal
expected: Lanes and pads both visible so you can play with thumbs
actual: Jam at 260x563 Warm Embers Normal: pads y=442..510 fully visible, scrollHeight 563 = viewport.

title: Reeling can never be lost by being bad: meter drains to 0 but the fish never gets away
steps: Cast and hook any fish (test hook: __angler.tap(); advance(bite.wait+0.3); tap())
Never hold the reel (or keep the zone off the fish) for 25+ seconds
expected: Fish escapes (a 'got away' result) when the catch meter empties or after a time limit, like a real fail state
actual: Hooked, no input: state went reeling -> result outcome "lost" ("It swam off. No harm done.", streak kept) after 7.8 s.

title: Song list shows a stale HUD from the last run (score, combo, accuracy, judgement, song name, full progress bar)
steps: Play Warm Embers Easy to the end (results), press Songs
expected: HUD hidden or reset on the song menu
actual: Song menu and results card no longer show the stale HUD (score/combo/judgement/song). Minor: the full gold progress bar still sits above the card.

title: Assist, Relax and Practice results are bare text, unlike the normal results card
steps: Menu > Assist (One thumb) ON > play Warm Embers Normal to the end
Also Relax mode and Practice > Start practice
expected: Same shared result card layout (rank, stars, stat chips, histogram, Play again first)
actual: Assist/Relax/Practice result cards not replayed this round.

title: Assist mode still draws 4 lanes and 4 pads with nothing marking which two lanes are live
steps: Menu > Assist ON > start a song, look at lanes at 9 s
expected: Obvious 2-lane layout (or pads merged), so a one-thumb player knows where to tap

title: Difficulty ladder is not monotonic and some Easy charts almost ignore lanes
steps: Generate every chart with MMJamSongs.chartFor(song, tier) and compare notes/sec and lane counts
expected: Later songs are harder at the same tier; Easy uses all four lanes

title: startSong() does not enforce the Hard lock; only the disabled UI button does
steps: With a save that has no Normal stars on Lantern Shuffle, call __jam.start('lantern-shuffle','hard') (test mode)
Perfect it
expected: Hard refuses to start until Normal has 2 stars
actual: Partly: start("warm-embers","hard") now returns null (locked Hard refused). But start("lantern-shuffle","hard") (the round-1 repro; song itself locked on a fresh save) still starts a run: the guard at jam.js:237 only refuses when the song is unlocked (`&& SG.songUnlocked(...)`), so a locked song + locked tier bypasses it.

title: Summary has weak hierarchy: the score line is the smallest text on the card
steps: Finish a Meadow run (90 s) on a phone
expected: Shared result card look: big score and stars, stat chips, clear next goal
actual: Bug Safari summary on 390x844 still leads with a tiny dim "Score 0 (best 0)" line; Bugs caught / Stars gained / Best combo plain text lines below the buttons. Test run was a 0-score idle run, so layout under a real score not seen.

title: Bugs are tiny and low contrast on the phone field; hard to tell species apart
steps: Open Bug Safari at 390x844, start Meadow
expected: Targets readable at a glance on a phone
actual: Phone field now fills ~340 px wide; ladybugs/butterflies ~16-20 px and clearly readable against the grass.

expected: Short player-facing text; Bug journal / Settings visible
actual: Desktop arena menu: dev-speak "?mods=0" text gone, short unlock rule, Bug journal and Settings buttons visible. Minor: HUD stub (90S / 0 / BEST 0) still above the menu.

title: Meadow 3 stars is trivially reached; two arenas unlock after one run

expected: First arena takes a few runs to master

expected: Each species reads as its animal
